_comment: Per-server contexts for UwU. Selection: UWU_SERVER env wins, else 'active', else 'home'. Missing file = home defaults, so live behavior never changes by accident. New servers: copy the guest block, set host/port. auth_password null = reuse the profile password for /register-/login prompts.

guest.notes: TEMPLATE for other servers: survival-only. No /tp /give /summon /effect /kick /setblock /data, no RCON, no auto-/login (a /login on a server without EasyAuth would paste the password into chat). First join: watcher answers AuthMe-style /register-/login prompts with auth_password (else profile password), max 2 tries each. TPA: /tprequest send, /tpaccept answer, auto-accept for trusted ranks, strangers go to the brain. Kit: no default kit — after auth settles she probes /kit list once and claims only an obvious starter kit, else reports the list and plays honest (walk, craft, mine, trade, ask players). Personality normal: no beloved, friendly kawaii, still fights back when really attacked (melee only, never console/TNT). version 'auto' negotiates with older servers; 26.3-only hacks auto-disable off 26.x. Seed null = unknown: !seed runs in ask-the-op mode until the owner stores the real seed here (crack it client-side with SeedcrackerX, paste the number).

home.notes: YandereCraft home. OP level 4, RCON console, EasyAuth /login, known seed, SimpleTPA tprequest/tpaccept/tpdeny/tpautoaccept. Yandere personality, full powers for the trusted.
